hedgespunBenefits.label: Extraordinary Equipment
hedgespunBenefits.effect: +1 equipment bonus, armor rating, or weapon damage modifier

hollowOptions.name: Hob Alarm
hollowOptions.description: Friendly hobgoblins prevent loss of Defense from surprise and add Hollow dots to actions during the first turn of an action scene. Requires Hob Kin and incurs 1 Goblin Debt each story.

hollowOptions.name: Luxury Goods
hollowOptions.description: Once per chapter, roll Hollow dots to produce one temporary mundane or Hedgespun item with Availability or rating no higher than successes.

hollowOptions.name: Shadow Garden
hollowOptions.description: Consumed goblin fruit reappears after one hour as a sensory-perfect but powerless shadow fruit; hunger it satisfies returns one hour later.

hollowOptions.name: Phantom Phone Booth
hollowOptions.description: Call any publicly listed mundane phone from the Hollow without knowing its number; traces falsely identify the recipient's own line.

hollowOptions.name: Route Zero
hollowOptions.description: A one-dot looping trod crosses the Hollow. A traveler who navigates it safely returns to the start and regains 1 Willpower, once per day.

hollowOptions.name: Size Matters 1
hollowOptions.description: The Hollow comfortably houses a motley of five or six changelings.

hollowOptions.name: Size Matters 2
hollowOptions.description: The Hollow becomes a vast estate or small town.

hollowOptions.name: Escape Route 1
hollowOptions.description: Adds a secure stationary one-way emergency exit usable by owners and permitted guests.

hollowOptions.name: Escape Route 2
hollowOptions.description: The one-way emergency exit may appear reflexively anywhere inside the Hollow.

hollowOptions.name: Hidden Entry
hollowOptions.description: The entrance vanishes while all contributing owners are inside; finding or forcing it while visible suffers a two-die penalty.

hollowOptions.name: Easy Access
hollowOptions.description: The Hollow has no fixed entrance; spend 1 Glamour to enter through any unlocked mundane door and exit where you entered.

hollowOptions.name: Home Turf
hollowOptions.description: The owner adds Hollow dots to Initiative and Defense against intruders inside the Hollow.

sharedBastionOptions.name: Buttressed Dreaming
sharedBastionOptions.description: Penalizes an opponent's Clash of Wills to force entry by the Shared Bastion rating.

sharedBastionOptions.name: Fixed Doorway
sharedBastionOptions.description: Requires Hollow. Creates a permanent Gate of Horn between that Hollow and the Bastion; each traveler spends 1 Glamour in each direction and may bring a passenger for +1 Glamour.

sharedBastionOptions.name: Guardian Eidolon
sharedBastionOptions.description: Spend 1 Willpower to wake the guardian for a scene. Owners cannot lose Defense to surprise and add Bastion dots to first-turn actions.

sharedBastionOptions.name: Illusory Armory
sharedBastionOptions.description: Once per chapter, spend Glamour to summon an unimportant prop with equipment rating twice Glamour spent, maximum +5; add 1 Willpower for an important prop.

sharedBastionOptions.name: Permanent Armory
sharedBastionOptions.description: Physical equipment remains safely stored in the Bastion. Each non-mundane item requires 1 Willpower per chapter or the Bastion absorbs it.

sharedBastionOptions.name: Raised Defenses
sharedBastionOptions.description: While an owner is inside, double the Bastion rating's defensive bonuses, to a maximum of +5.

sharedBastionOptions.name: Subtle Speech
sharedBastionOptions.description: Fixed eidolons relay private messages of up to five words from the Bastion to waking motley members.
